items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: Higbee, Mumpfield, Parkinson, Atwell, Whittington, Allen. McVay: felt lack of power/explosion; will test pregame.
items.why: Calf; majority Thursday practice then stopped; minor per reports but no full explosion.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if OUT heavy TE/WR funnel to Higbee etc and remaining Rams pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Higbee/Parkinson elevated if inactive; Puka still high-upside if ACTIVE.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed OUT Week 7; 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most), recent RBs saw heavy catches; sweet setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: Hamstring; official out; 49ers allowing RB catches (White 4-30-1, Harvey 10-68 etc).
items.implication: Bijan full workload vs soft DvP; upside skyrockets without handcuff stealing TDs/touches.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet headed to IR with season-ending serious knee injury suffered Thursday night; coach Ben Johnson confirmed.
items.why: Carted off Thursday; testing confirmed serious knee; coach called it season-ending and 'big part of our heartbeat'.
items.implication: TE/WR opportunity expands in Bears offense with Caleb Williams back.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Loveland (already 30% share post-Caleb) and Burden (elite YPRR).

items.text: Ravens officially list QB Lamar Jackson questionable for Sunday vs Bengals (ankle).
items.why: High-ankle sprain direction earlier; returned to practice but official Q.
items.implication: Game-time lean; if OUT major downgrade for Ravens pass-catchers/Henry script change.
items.opportunity: Monitor for ACTIVE confirmation; beneficiaries if out limited.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (thank you Caleb): since Williams return 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yds both games.
items.why: Post-Caleb Williams return stats; now further juice possible from Kmet IR.
items.opportunity: High target share + efficiency; more with Kmet out.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: awesome player/scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (not National TE Day).
items.implication: Elite TE1 upside this week vs Falcons.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out again this week by coach Mike LaFleur after high-ankle sprain.
items.why: High-ankle; trying to get right but misses another game.
items.implication: Cardinals RB depth thins; other backs elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.implication: TE targets redistribute; Colts pass game thinner.
items.opportunity: Possible bump to other Colts pass-catchers like Downs/Pierce if active.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2-/3-TE sets giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Route rate + efficiency; Kmet season-ending opens more WR sets.
items.implication: Higher ceiling ROS/week with expanded opportunity post-Kmet.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks.
Josh Jacobs allowed in facility for meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush, Kaleb Johnson 53rd among qualifiers (OL mess too).
items.why: Facility access positive; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs return path clearer long-term; avoid backups short-term.
items.opportunity: If Jacobs returns soon, role reclaims; else poor backup production.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on workload post-layoff.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (back in real role, Bears good for yardage) and DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume).
items.why: Bears matchup yardage; Smith volume; Brown role restored.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved by RBs; Hubbard consistency.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Cam Skattebo @ HOU.
items.why: Jacobs layoff/role; tough matchups (Odunze/Kelce); Downs target share/low scoring; Skattebo brutal spot.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility progress and backup inefficiency.
